title: Cutting
subtitle: Saw position and sizes
text:
The saw's position in the grid sets the cut axis.

Saw directly above or below the block: a horizontal cut.

Saw beside or diagonal to the block: a vertical cut.

Put the saw in the grid with one block, or with a piece you have already cut. Each cut gives 2 pieces.

steps.title: Full block
steps.text: 2 slabs from a horizontal cut, or 2 vertical slabs from a vertical cut.

steps.title: Vertical slab
steps.text: 2 quarters from a horizontal cut, or 2 vertical quarters from a vertical cut.
